## minicore `Drop::drop`: the default body is `rustc_default_body_unstable`, as in the pinned core

crates/test-utils/src/minicore.rs:700-710: real core (nightly-2026-10-27, library/core/src/ops/drop.rs:241-243) always gives `fn drop(&mut self)` a default body calling `pin_drop`, with `#[rustc_default_body_unstable(feature = "pin_ergonomics", issue = "130494")]`, and has `pin_drop`. minicore has the body only under `region:pin` and lacks the attribute, so a test of `impl Drop for S {}` can't check E0046 the way real code meets it. Change: add the attribute to `drop` (with `#![feature(staged_api)]`-style acceptance as minicore's other rustc_ attributes need). The db-lane request on E0046 and unstable default bodies is the semantic half. Test: blaze-diagnostics tests::items::impls::a_missing_drop_method.

history.note: minicore.rs Drop::drop has #[rustc_default_body_unstable(feature = "pin_ergonomics", issue = "130494")]; with tests-diag edit 84 items::impls::a_missing_drop_method passes, and fails with the attribute removed
